STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_060820.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_060820.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_060820 (
    CLOCK_50,
    SW,
    LEDG,
    BUTTON,
    HEX0,
    HEX1,
    HEX2,
    HEX3,
    HEX2_DP,
    VGA_R,
    VGA_G,
    VGA_HS,
    VGA_VS
);
  input CLOCK_50;
  input [7:0] SW;
  input [2:0] BUTTON;
  output [9:0] LEDG;
  output [6:0] HEX0, HEX1, HEX2, HEX3;
  output HEX2_DP;
  output [3:0] VGA_R, VGA_G;
  output VGA_HS, VGA_VS;

  wire [2:0] game_over, correct;
  wire [1199:0] framebuffer;
  wire [4:0] ypos1, ypos2, ypos3;
  wire [7:0] score_wire, letter1, letter2, letter3;

  wire [6:0] seven_seg_hex0;
  wire [6:0] seven_seg_hex1;
  wire [6:0] ones_hex2;
  wire [6:0] tens_hex3;
  wire [3:0] ones;
  wire [3:0] tens;
  wire [3:0] hundreds;

  wire [2:0] reset_signal;
  wire [2:0] reset_signal_delay;

  assign HEX2_DP = 1'b0;

  Big_State_Machine big_state_machine (
      .reset_button(~BUTTON[2]),
      .game_over(game_over),
      .correct(correct),
      .reset_signal(reset_signal),
      .score(score_wire),
      .clock(CLOCK_50)
  );

  Column column1 (
      .clock(CLOCK_50),
      .user_input(SW[7:0]),
      .reset_signal(reset_signal_delay[0]),
      .ypos(ypos1),
      .game_over(game_over[0]),
      .correct(correct[0]),
      .letter(letter1)
  );

  Column column2 (
      .clock(CLOCK_50),
      .user_input(SW[7:0]),
      .reset_signal(reset_signal_delay[1]),
      .ypos(ypos2),
      .game_over(game_over[1]),
      .correct(correct[1]),
      .letter(letter2)
  );

  Column column3 (
      .clock(CLOCK_50),
      .user_input(SW[7:0]),
      .reset_signal(reset_signal_delay[2]),
      .ypos(ypos3),
      .game_over(game_over[2]),
      .correct(correct[2]),
      .letter(letter3)
  );

  Display display (
      .clock(CLOCK_50),
      .letter1(letter1),
      .letter2(letter2),
      .letter3(letter3),
      .ypos1(ypos1),
      .ypos2(ypos2),
      .ypos3(ypos3),
      .framebuffer(framebuffer)
  );

  VGA vga (
      .clk(CLOCK_50),
      .data(framebuffer),
      .red_out(VGA_R),
      .green_out(VGA_G),
      .h_sync_out(VGA_HS),
      .v_sync_out(VGA_VS)
  );

  Reset_Flow reset_flow (
      .clock(CLOCK_50),
      .reset_in(reset_signal),
      .reset_out(reset_signal_delay)
  );

  //assign LEDG[2:0] = reset_signal_delay;

  assign HEX0 = ~seven_seg_hex0;
  assign HEX1 = ~seven_seg_hex1;
  assign HEX2 = ~ones_hex2;
  assign HEX3 = ~tens_hex3;

  Seven_Seg hex0 (
      SW[3:0],
      seven_seg_hex0
  );
  Seven_Seg hex1 (
      SW[7:4],
      seven_seg_hex1
  );
  Seven_Seg hex2 (
      ones,
      ones_hex2
  );
  Seven_Seg hex3 (
      tens,
      tens_hex3
  );
  Binary_BCD one_hex2 (
      score_wire,
      ones,
      tens,
      hundreds
  );


endmodule

A stored instruction is distinct from the runtime launch message, which can add framing and execution limits. The agent uses the harness’s file-reading tools to inspect available inputs.
